# homelab-glossary

Terms that keep coming up in the homelab notes, collected in one place instead of re-explained every
time.

- **hypervisor** — software that runs virtual machines; see [[proxmox]]
- **QDevice** — a lightweight quorum voter that doesn't run VMs itself, just breaks ties
- **VLAN** — a way to split one physical network into isolated logical ones
- **corosync** — the cluster heartbeat protocol Proxmox nodes use to detect each other

For orchestration terms outside this homelab's current stack, see [[kubernetes-notes]] — not written
yet, this link is a placeholder.
